name: io.github.tonyyang0504/xiaohongshu_pugongying-mcp
description: 小红书 聚光 / 蒲公英 Xiaohongshu Ads (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Eve

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_XIAOHONGSHU_PUGONGYING_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: app_id of the 小红书开放平台 聚光 (MAPI) application (应用中心 > 编辑应用).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_XIAOHONGSHU_PUGONGYING_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: secret of that application (应用中心 > 编辑应用); sent as `secret` in the refresh call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_XIAOHONGSHU_PUGONGYING_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: refresh_token from 获取token (auth_code exchange after the advertiser authorised the app's url). Valid 30 days and replaced on every refresh ('刷新后会生成新的 token，老的 access_token 和 refresh_token 将不可再使用'); set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the newest one survives restarts.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_XIAOHONGSHU_PUGONGYING_ADVERTISER_ID
environmentVariables.description: 聚光 广告主ID (advertiser_id; returned as approval_advertisers with the token); used by the probe, update_budget and pause_resume.
